title: Avatar Studio
theme: Identity, future-self ownership, profile personalisation, and shop unlocks

overview.tagline: Create a personalised future-self avatar that follows the student through Career Empire.
overview.playerFantasy: Build a version of yourself that can unlock gear, career outfits, interview looks, life items, and future goals through gameplay.
overview.teacherValue: Creates early student ownership and captures aspiration evidence before career-planning, training, and interview modules expand the profile.

learningObjectives: Identify an occupation or career area the student is curious about.
Connect avatar choices to a future-self profile rather than decoration alone.
Name training, skills, or experience that may be needed for a future pathway.
Reflect on a personal strength that could support employability.

sharedStatEffects.description: A clear future-self profile strengthens motivation and ownership across later modules.
Students build a personalised identity they can carry into interview and career-planning activities.
Later shop unlocks can connect avatar upgrades to savings, spending, and long-term goals.

gameplayLoop.label: Create identity
gameplayLoop.description: The student selects an ECC-quality character base, profile style choices, clothing, and accessories.

gameplayLoop.label: Set future intent
gameplayLoop.description: The student names an occupation, training need, and strength.

gameplayLoop.label: Save profile
gameplayLoop.description: The avatar becomes part of the student's Career Empire session.

gameplayLoop.label: Unlock upgrades
gameplayLoop.description: Future shop stages add interview outfits, career gear, vehicles, rooms, and life items.

employabilityFocus.whyItFits: Students explain who they are becoming and what they want their profile to show.
Later versions will ask students to connect occupations to training pathways and evidence.
Future career-plan stages should require students to sequence training, practice, and interview preparation.

activities.title: Avatar Creator
activities.purpose: Let students create a personalised future-self avatar with inclusive starter options.

activities.title: Future Self Card
activities.purpose: Capture the student's current occupation interest, training idea, and employability strength.

activities.title: Avatar Unlocks
activities.purpose: Preview how shop unlocks can connect cosmetic choices to career gear and life goals.

assessmentEvidence.prompt: What occupation are you curious about, what training might you need, and what personal strength do you want to build?

visualLanguage.artDirectionDecision: The generated SVG avatar is a wireframe only. Production avatar art should use ECC-quality character bases and generated modular parts only when they match the existing Emmanuel character standard.
